scope: Tutorial-plaza read-only entity observations. No screenshots, native capture, desktop input or memory writes. Diagnostic sampling is not a performance acceptance run.
method: Bounded first 128 slots of the inspected entity pool, stride 0xa38. Name field at +0x44 has an 8-bit generation tag and 24-bit identity. Position at +0x4c; current/recovery/maximum health fields at +0x2a0/+0x2a4/+0x2a8. Recovery and maximum-health normalization code supports these field meanings. Private state-specific contracts identify four heroes and known plaza opponents; no game strings or RAM content is included here.
guards: Require exact bounded probe size and four-byte generation, matching expected generation, unique expected heroes, finite bounded fields; ignore zero-flag and stale-generation slots and unclassified identities. Private live wrapper checks living heroes/opponents and a conservative 1800-unit hero radius around the inspected plaza reference before sending the next batch of process-local input. These checks do not model the complete entity lifecycle or visibility.
conditions: Unchanged 242dd198 runtime; whole process CPU2/mask4, full JIT, Vulkan3x/1920x1080 preset, normal clocks, Cubeb Volume0, formatter ON, identity cache ON, backpatch reserve524288. Existing short plaza input route with explicit memory/timing reads. No runtime timing profile or screenshots.
native_build: No native source change or rebuild this checkpoint. Prior supported Windows build exit0 and 39/39 tests in7.21s remain the binary provenance; existing CMake warnings recorded in PLAZA-BACKPATCH-RESERVE.json.
new_test_scope: Tagged identifiers; current/recovery/maximum field placement; stale/freed exclusion; missing/duplicate hero rejection; non-finite/out-of-bound fields; exact probe length and contract bounds; generation changes/truncated headers; unclassified objects not treated as enemies; input bytes unchanged.

live_summary.interpretation: Observed adjacent-sample deltas, not event counts: slot reuse with the same identity is possible. Positive health alone does not establish hostile AI activity or visibility. No claim about unsampled intervals.

long_endpoint.interpretation: The old endpoint cannot prove uninterrupted same-generation combat. The cause and time of the generation change are unproven.

first_attempt.failure: Wrapper assumed a timing sidecar from read_memory; absent file stopped before the first input batch. Corrected route explicitly requests read_timing. This failed attempt is not validation evidence.

verification: All 15 completed live probes rechecked with final guarded analyzer; old generation-changed endpoint rejects. CLI successfully reads the last live probe. No fresh FPS, clean-audio or visual-correctness claim.
decision: Retain read-only diagnostics for distinguishing observed combat activity from idle/stale/reloaded state. No changes to game simulation or performance settings in normal launch. Goal remains unmet; sampled movement/health changes do not establish every interval or ten-minute continuous combat.
